title: OmniAgentOS profile overlay (OPTIONAL)
description: House doctrine layered ON TOP of envelope.schema.json. A loop that validates against the base envelope alone is fully conforming and interoperable - this overlay is what THIS estate additionally demands of ITS OWN loops. Do not impose it on third-party loops. Validate with both schemas when you want the stricter contract.

lineage.description: anthropic | openai | google | xai | moonshot | human. Used to enforce cross-lineage review.

substituted_from.description: Set when provider failover picked a different seat than intended. A shrunken or substituted panel must never be presented as the full one.

third_party.description: Set true ONLY by a loop this estate does not run. It does not waive risk policy: risky real diffs still require exact-SHA cross-lineage approval; routine diffs do not require a verdict from any producer.

verdicts.description: Build-time cross-lineage review for risky real diffs. Lineage inequality and reviewed_sha equality are enforced mechanically by the lander.

lineage.description: REQUIRED: the gate's cross-lineage check keys on this field, so a verdict that omits it is not a disclosed review — and used to be admitted as one.

reviewed_sha.description: Exact candidate head_sha this verdict approves.

allOf.$comment: This estate requires a carrier enumeration on every candidate: the codebase has 518 clone families, so a fix is structurally 2-13 fixes more often than not.

ruling.description: 'reached' or 'not-applicable - <reason>'. A row you cannot rule is a row you have not understood.

allOf.$comment: This estate requires every proposal to be falsifiable and lane-split.

then.$comment: paths is a TOP-LEVEL envelope field, not a payload field - the estate requires it on proposals so Integration can build its conflict graph before an Executor picks the plan up.

falsifier.description: What observation would prove this plan UNNECESSARY. If you cannot write one, you do not understand the problem well enough to propose a fix for it.

lanes.description: File-disjoint parallel splits, with known conflicts named.

tests_required.description: For each: what it must FAIL against.
